description: Target JSON schema for migrated sales CRM opportunity/deal records.

country.description: Country or region of the sales deal.

deal_id.description: Unique deal or opportunity identifier from the source system.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email for the deal.

expected_close_date.description: Expected deal closure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

customer_segment.description: Customer classification, account grade, or segment.

tax_id.description: Tax identifier such as VAT ID or GST number.

source_file.description: Name of the source file from which the record came.
